status: Fixture re-measure only. The real-model (Huihui-Qwen3.5-2B 32K) frame measurement is UNMEASURED. Nothing pinned into PALW_TIR_FRAME_COST_RECORDS_V1.

result: Every deterministic count and byte size (2087 leaves compared, nanosecond fields excluded) is identical to docs/design/palw/evidence/tir-frame-measure-2026-10-16/frame-ops-after.json; only host label and source commit differ. The 10-16 baseline (action_parser_steps 15,625,804, per custodian 18,575, frame_passes_per_check 2, control_bytes 14,320) is therefore reproduced on this source for the fixtures, not confirmed for the real model.

unmeasured.real_model_frame_operations: The harness builds the court from an in-memory MapParams whose Tensor stores Vec<i128>; the Huihui PALWART3 (2.54 GB of instances) would need ~16x that in RAM (> 32 GiB). The node backend TirArtifactV1 opens only PALWTIR1, and PALWART3 is read only through PalwArtTirParamsV3 in SDK deep verify. A streamed court source for PALWART3 in the harness is required first.
unmeasured.contended_bytes_per_daa: needs a loaded devnet; parallel_bytes_per_daa 125,000 stays a theoretical upper bound only
unmeasured.recovery_amount_reorg_replay_moves: needs V7 restart/reorg drill; not run
